output.title: BREAKING: HTTP01 challenge paths use Exact PathType; review ingress compatibility
output.content: This is a breaking change that alters HTTP01 ACME challenge Ingress path handling from ImplementationSpecific to Exact PathType. The environment has global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole configured, indicating HTTP01 challenges are in use. This change improves security and compatibility with standards-compliant controllers (like Cilium) but may affect ingress controllers that don't handle Exact paths correctly. Review your ingress controller compatibility before upgrading.
